description: A PostToolUse[Edit|Write] reminder toward Emil Kowalski's design-engineering skill family, tailored to whatever impeccable's own detector finds on the just-edited file when impeccable happens to be set up for that project - a motion/easing finding points at animate/review-animations, any other visual finding points at emil-design-eng/apple-design, no impeccable install or a clean scan falls back to a generic reminder. Fires once per session per project, never invokes a skill itself - only injects a reminder into context.
